hyperedges.label: Admin Auth Guard Pattern — Both admin layouts redirect unauthenticated users to /login
Inquiry CRUD Flow — Pages, form, and server actions for creating/editing inquiries
Order Lifecycle — Kanban board, detail view, status transitions, ETA, invoice
WhatsApp Messaging Pattern — Confirmation link, order ready, balance due messages via wa.me URLs
Rate Limiting Middleware — Route-specific sliding window limits via Upstash
Nav Badge Counts — Admin layout queries pending inquiry + ready order counts for sidebar/bottom nav badges
Customer Lookup & Pre-fill — InquiryForm debounces phone lookup, shows CustomerHistoryPanel, prefills cake details
Admin Settings Sub-pages (Business, Operating Rules, Pricing, Blackout Dates, WhatsApp Templates, Options)
Public Inquiry Submission Flow (rate-limit → upsert customer → insert inquiry → insert delivery address → notify)
Image Upload Pipeline (sharp resize → Supabase storage → inquiry_images record)
Customer Order Confirmation Flow (ConfirmPage → ConfirmForm → confirmInquiry action → redirect to /track)
Core Database Schema (Inquiries, Orders, Notifications, Customers)
